Rhinox CLI

Usage: rhinox <command> [options]
       rhinox migrate <subcommand> [options]

Commands:
  introspect            Connect to a live database and write db/schema/*.sql files
  migrate plan          Show pending changes without writing
  migrate generate      Generate migration file from schema changes
  migrate apply         Apply pending migrations to database
  migrate status        Show migration status

Options:
  --connection <conn>       PostgreSQL connection string (required for introspect/apply/status; optional for plan/generate to diff against live DB)
  --migrations-dir <path>   Migrations directory (default: db/migrations)
  --schema-dir <path>       Schema directory (default: db/schema)
  --schemas <list>          Comma-separated schemas to introspect (default: public)
  --name <name>             Custom migration name (for plan/generate)
  --target <prefix>         Apply up to specific migration (for apply)
  --repair                  Repair checksums for modified migration files (for apply)
